hero.headline: Luo UGC ads for the world's best brands.
hero.body: Rekisteröidy to work with some of the world's biggest brands — signing up once means you could work with brands like Perplexity, Lovable, Bolt, Hims and more.
hero.footnote: Unsure if it's for you? Check out some of our case studies below.

guide.heading: Etkö ole vielä varma, onko tämä sinua varten?
guide.body: Tutustu tekijän oppaaseemme – kattava opas siihen, miten kuvaat sisältöä, joka hyväksytään heti ensimmäisellä kerralla, ja miten toimit alustallamme.

descriptions.verify_email_pending: Lähetimme vahvistuslinkin osoitteeseen {email}. Avaa se viimeistelläksesi tilin luomisen.
descriptions.forgot_password: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
descriptions.enable_2fa_intro: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the manual key. Then confirm by entering the six-digit code.
descriptions.auth_bootstrap_error: We could not load your account information. Check your connection and try again.
descriptions.recovery_codes_warning: Tallenna these one-time codes somewhere safe. They are your only way to sign in if you lose access to your authenticator.
